newsitem.title: USA: Executive Risk revamps business with Aetna.
newsitem.headline: Executive Risk revamps business with Aetna.

text.p: Executive Risk Inc said Thursday it restructured its relationship with The Aetna Casualty and Surety Co.
Aetna Casualty and Surety Co is a subsidiary of Travelers/Aetna Property Casualty Corp.

As part of that restructured relationship, Executive Risk said it will continue to be authorized to underwrite and issue directors and officers liability insurance (D&O) on Aetna policies, but on a non-exclusive basis.
Effective January 1, 1997, Executive Risk will reinsure, on a 100 percent quota share basis, all such Aetna D&O business and will pay Aetna a ceding commission that approximates actual costs.
Previously, Executive Risk said it had a 50 percent quota share participation of this business.
